# @neural-ng/core/select

Current component maturity: beta.

Angular 22+ standalone, Signal-first Select.

IMPORT
import { NeuralSelect, OptionComponent, type NeuralSelectChange } from '@neural-ng/core/select';

PREFERRED DATA API
<neural-select
  [options]="cities"
  optionLabel="name"
  optionValue="id"
  [(value)]="cityId"
  placeholder="Select a city"
  clearable
  (selectionChange)="citySelected($event)"
/>

FORMS API
<!-- Signal Forms -->
<neural-select [options]="cities" [formField]="form.city" />

<!-- Reactive Forms -->
<neural-select [options]="cities" [formControl]="cityControl" />

<!-- Template-driven Forms -->
<neural-select [options]="cities" name="city" [(ngModel)]="city" />

PROJECTED API
<neural-select [(value)]="status">
  <neural-option value="ready" label="Ready" iconClass="nt-circle-check">
    Ready
  </neural-option>
</neural-select>

RULES
- NeuralSelect implements FormValueControl<TValue | null>.
- Bind the model with [(value)] or use [formField], [formControl], or [(ngModel)].
- Programmatic Forms writes update value without emitting selectionChange.
- Use either [options] or neural-option children in one instance, not both.
- optionLabel, optionValue, optionDisabled, and optionIcon support nested
  property paths. Primitive arrays need no mappings.
- valueChange is the generated model output. selectionChange is the detailed
  user-only event with value, previousValue, option, and source.
- source is "pointer" or "keyboard".
- Selecting the current value again does not emit a duplicate selectionChange.
- Use cleared for explicit clear actions and openChange for panel state.
- readonly is not disabled: the trigger remains enabled and focusable,
  aria-readonly is exposed, and pointer, keyboard, and clear mutation are blocked.
- touch emits when focus leaves the control. focus() targets the trigger and
  reset() restores null.
- appendTo defaults to self. Use appendTo="body" inside clipped scroll,
  table, or dialog surfaces; it uses the browser top layer and shared Overlay
  positioner without requiring a global container.
- Do not invent onSelected, onChange, or onSelectLink outputs.
- Build chained selects by updating the dependent options Signal from the
  parent value/selectionChange. Reset the dependent value explicitly.
- Set loading while dependent async options load.
- neural-option requires both value and label. label is used for selection
  display, typeahead, and accessible text; projected content renders in the
  list.
- iconClass values such as nt-map-pin automatically receive the nt base class.
- Use unstyled for local headless mode or provideNeuralNg({ unstyled: true })
  globally. Keep structural classes; replace visual classes with classes slots.
- Preserve combobox/listbox semantics and keyboard behavior.
- Inside neural-field, Select inherits id, descriptions, required, invalid,
  disabled, readonly, fluid, and unstyled state.
- For fixed-height large lists use virtualScroll with virtualItemSize,
  virtualScrollHeight and virtualOverscan.
- Select shares option resolution, enabled navigation and typeahead primitives
  with MultiSelect through @neural-ng/core.
